name: Maharasnadi Kashayam (Kwath)

sections.overview: Maharasnadi Kashayam (Kwath) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Maharasnadi Kashayam (Kwath) is an herbal formulation. It cures Vata disorders like arthritis, infertility, filariasis, locked jaw, sperm disorders, gout, hernia, and knee pain etc. This medicine pacifies vata dosha. While consuming this medicine you should avoid vata aggravating foods like peas, cauliflower, spices. You should also eat light and easily digestible food. Cumin, Asafetida, Bitter gourd, Bottle gourd help in reducing aggravated vata.

 Clean the ingredients and add them to 8 parts of water and put it over flame. Boil it till it reduces to just 1/4th part and let it cool down. Once cooled, filter the concoction and store it in dark bottles away from heat and light.

fullContent:
Maharasnadi Kashayam (Kwath) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sharangadhara Samhita 
 Introduction 
 Maharasnadi Kashayam (Kwath) is an herbal formulation. It cures Vata disorders like arthritis, infertility, filariasis, locked jaw, sperm disorders, gout, hernia, and knee pain etc. This medicine pacifies vata dosha. While consuming this medicine you should avoid vata aggravating foods like peas, cauliflower, spices. You should also eat light and easily digestible food. Cumin, Asafetida, Bitter gourd, Bottle gourd help in reducing aggravated vata. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) 
 Dhanvayasa (Alhagi pseudalhagi) 
 Country mallow (Sida cordifolia) 
 Castor root (Ricinus communis) 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Shati (Hedychium spicatum) 
 Vacha (Acorus calamus) 
 Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba) 
 Musta (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Punarnava (Boerhavia diffusa) 
 Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia) 
 Vriddhadaru (Argyria speciosa) 
 Shatapushpa (Anethum sowa) 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) 
 Prativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 Golden rain tree (Cassia fistula) 
 Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Porcupine flower (Barleria prionitis) 
 Yellow berried nightshade (Solanum xanthocarpum) 
 Coriander seeds (Coriandrum sativum) 
 Poison berry (Solanum indicum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean the ingredients and add them to 8 parts of water and put it over flame. Boil it till it reduces to just 1/4th part and let it cool down. Once cooled, filter the concoction and store it in dark bottles away from heat and light. 
 Dosage 
 12 to 24 ml before meals with equal amounts of water. 
 Indications 
 
 Parkinson’s disease 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Osteoarthritis 
 Knee pain 
 Pelvic pain 
 Lower backache 
 Paraplegia 
 Hemiplegia 
 Bloating 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no reported side effects. 
 Self-medication should be avoided. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
